transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the release package review for 'After the Flood' ahead of the Meridian International Film Festival. I'll need each of you — rights, music, publicity, and accessibility — to walk me through your review of the current draft release sheet before I lock it. I have the draft in front of me: worldwide access, the cue 'Low Tide,' the working title 'River After Rain,' and optional accessibility materials. We also know the festival will receive both a public screening file and a password-protected press-screening file. Who'd like to begin?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights issue before we go any further. I confirmed with the archive this week that the license for the documentary's archival interview permits festival screening and password-protected press access only in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Ireland. It forbids public online access and access in all other territories. The archive's signed email arrived after the last package revision, so I haven't been able to copy the confirmation into the release sheet yet. The current draft lists 'worldwide access,' which directly conflicts with the territorial restriction in the license.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a music clearance issue. I confirmed with the publisher that the current cue 'Low Tide' is only cleared for 30 seconds, but the trailer segment it's used in runs 46 seconds. The alternate cue 'Northbound' is cleared for the full 46-second segment. I haven't replaced the cue name in the package yet because the editor delivered the latest cut after my clearance check, so the draft release sheet still lists 'Low Tide.' We need to switch the cue to 'Northbound' before this package is locked.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: On the publicity side, I need to flag a title and credit issue. I have the filmmaker's signed publicity approval, which requires the title 'After the Flood' and the credit line 'A film by Nia Okafor.' The working title 'River After Rain' and a generic credit are still in the current draft because the signed approval arrived during the poster revision cycle, so I haven't been able to update the release sheet yet. We need to correct both the title and the credit line before Mara locks the package.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: On the accessibility side, I need to flag a critical deliverables issue. I confirmed with the festival's access coordinator that the final submission must include open English captions and a separate audio-description track. The coordinator will reject a package containing either deliverable as optional. The current draft release sheet lists accessibility materials as optional, which directly conflicts with this requirement. The festival issued this ingest requirement in a separate accessibility email, so I haven't updated the release checklist yet. We need to make both open English captions and the audio-description track mandatory deliverables before Mara locks the package.
transcript.speaker: A5

Replace cue 'Low Tide' with 'Northbound' and record full 46-second clearance.
Replace working title 'River After Rain' with 'After the Flood' and add credit line 'A film by Nia Okafor'; attach signed publicity approval.
Mark open English captions and audio-description track as mandatory deliverables; attach festival accessibility email.
